title: The Barnet movie: Paul Cohen posed for McGhee's part
summary: Columbia used McGhee's sound track but filmed Paul Cohen.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Well, several things in life that were a drag. Like, when I was with Charlie, everybody was talking about Charlie was a champion for using colored guys. So I figured, I said, "Well, yeah, I'll go in and see what's happening." So I went into the band, and I didn't realize that this same shit wherever you go is still there. In Charlie's case, I think it's that Columbia wouldn't let him use colored guys in the band...

Yeah, in the movie. So they used our music, but they didn't use us. They had Paul Cohen playing my part. Because Charlie had to feature me on that "Cherokee," and he would play that tag thing, what do you call that...

"Redskin Rhumba," yeah. I used to have to play over the band and answer the band. So they wouldn't take pictures of me playing it. They used Paul Cohen. So I... What's the name of the guy who lives down the street
here? You know who I'm talking about. He's got all the pictures.
Oh, David Chertok. He's got the movies.
He's got the movies, yeah. So I saw some of the things around that...
And you said "That's me on the sound track."
Yeah, that's on the sound track. I said, "Yeah, that's me." But they had Paul Cohen posing for it.
Well, things like this all kind of add up and I guess put you in a certain frame of mind.

Yeah. You know, it's kind of hard to take when you know that... I mean, people just do it for the fun of it, it seems like sometimes. Like, what the hell. You can't expect the best of everything. If it wasn't (?), it had to be something else; if it wasn't one thing, it would be another. That's the way life is, man.
